map.根据父母身高预测子女遗传靶身高及成年身高范围: Predict a child's genetic target height and adult height range from parents' heights
map.📖 查看「儿童成年身高预测使用指南」: 📖 View the "Child Adult Height Prediction Guide"
map.男孩靶身高(cm) = (父身高 + 母身高 + 13) ÷ 2: Boy target height (cm) = (father height + mother height + 13) ÷ 2
map.女孩靶身高(cm) = (父身高 + 母身高 − 13) ÷ 2；预期范围 =: Girl target height (cm) = (father height + mother height − 13) ÷ 2; expected range = target height ± 5 cm
map.Pass X光片评估骨龄，结合当前身高预测成年身高，是最准确的方法，需到医院进行: Assess bone age via X-ray and predict adult height combined with current height; the most accurate method, done at a hospital.
map.通过X光片评估骨龄，结合当前身高预测成年身高，是最准确的方法，需到医院进行。: Assess bone age via X-ray and predict adult height combined with current height; the most accurate method, done at a hospital.
map.定期监测身高，绘制生长曲线，根据趋势预测。: Monitor height regularly, plot a growth curve and predict by trend.
map.2岁时身高 × 2 约等于成年身高（粗略估计）。: Height at age 2 x 2 is about adult height (rough estimate).
map.遗传靶身高预测有 ± 5 cm 的误差范围是正常的。如果孩子的实际生长明显偏离预: A ± 5 cm error range in genetic target height prediction is normal. If a child's actual growth clearly deviates from the prediction, consult a pediatric endocrinologist.
map.每日保证充足优质蛋白质（鱼、禽、蛋、奶、豆制品）: Ensure adequate high-quality protein daily (fish, poultry, eggs, milk, soy foods)
map.• 多吃海产品、坚果、瘦肉: • Eat more seafood, nuts, lean meat
map.• 弹跳类：跳绳、篮球、排球、跳高: • Bouncing: jump rope, basketball, volleyball, high jump
map.• 每天至少60分钟中等强度运动: • At least 60 minutes of moderate-intensity exercise daily
map.• 每周至少3次弹跳或伸展运动: • At least 3 bouncing or stretching sessions per week
map.• 避免过度负重运动（如大重量举重）: • Avoid excessive weight-bearing exercise (e.g. heavy weightlifting)
map.• 深睡眠时分泌最旺盛: • Secreted most actively during deep sleep
map.• 夜间分泌量占全天70%以上: • Night secretion accounts for over 70% of the day
map.• 规律作息，定时入睡起床: • Regular schedule, fixed sleep and wake times
map.• 保持卧室黑暗、安静、凉爽: • Keep bedroom dark, quiet and cool
map.出现以下情况建议咨询儿科内分泌医生：: Consult a pediatric endocrinologist if the following occur:
map.• 身高明显低于同龄儿童（第3百分位以下）: • Height clearly below peers (below the 3rd percentile)
map.• 年生长速度低于4-5cm（学龄期后）: • Annual growth rate below 4-5 cm (after school age)
map.• 青春期过早或过晚出现: • Puberty too early or too late
map.• 父母身高正常但孩子明显偏矮: • Parents normal height but child clearly short
map.• 骨龄与实际年龄相差2岁以上: • Bone age differs from actual age by over 2 years
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考，身高预测基于遗传因素估算，实际身高受营养、运动、睡眠、疾病: ⚠️ This tool is for reference only; height prediction is estimated from genetic factors, and actual height is affected by nutrition, exercise, sleep, disease and other factors. For growth concerns, consult a pediatrician.
map.用父母身高（中亲身高法）预估子女成年身高区间，作为生长发育参考基线。: Use parents' height (mid-parental height method) to estimate a child's adult height range as a growth reference baseline.
map.比对预测值与当前实测身高百分位，判断生长是否沿预期轨迹。: Compare the prediction with the current measured height percentile to judge whether growth follows the expected trajectory.
map.科普遗传与环境（营养/运动/睡眠）对最终身高的影响权重。: Explain the weight of genetics and environment (nutrition/exercise/sleep) on final height.

map.父母都不高，孩子就一定矮吗？: If both parents are short, will the child be short for sure?
map.遗传决定约 70–80%，但营养、睡眠、运动、疾病等占 20–30%。预测值只是: Genetics decides about 70-80%, but nutrition, sleep, exercise and disease account for 20-30%. The prediction is only the interval midpoint; good postnatal management can approach or even slightly exceed the upper limit; prediction cannot replace pediatric growth monitoring.
map.为什么男孩加 6.5、女孩减 6.5？: Why add 6.5 for boys and subtract 6.5 for girls?
map.这是中亲身高法的经验校正值（男孩约 +6.5 cm、女孩约 −6.5 cm，即: This is the empirical correction of the mid-parental height method (boys about +6.5 cm, girls about −6.5 cm, i.e. ±13/2), from the adult height difference between sexes. For finer results use the Tanner bone-age method; this tool gives a range rather than a single point, which is more accurate.
